svg.aria-label: Trust zones, least to most trusted. Zone 1 Untrusted: the internet via STC. Zone 2 Perimeter: the ISR 4331 doing NAT, then the OPNsense firewall with Suricata IDS on a CloudGenix ION 3000. Zone 3 Trusted LAN: core and access switches with VLAN 10 Management, VLAN 20 Internal and VLAN 40 Servers routed at the core, VLAN 60 Cameras for the cameras and the NVR, and VLAN 30 Guest limited to the internet. Zone 4 Management: SSH access limited by the Admin-SSH access list to the admin workstation at 192.168.10.1.
svg.title: Trust zones
